$Comment: Harvest Feast lifts Harvesting XP for everyone on the server while it runs, on a server running MMO
Skill Tree: the hytale:mod_installed condition in Requires leaves the file out without it.
A standing boost: nobody starts it and it keeps no timer. It lifts every gain in the skills it names
while the rest of its Requires passes, and it counts as a server boost, so the cap in
mods/ziggfreedcommon/boost-settings.json bounds it like any other boost.
Tracks.Ids names the skills. Percent is how much more XP they earn: 25 is a quarter more.
ziggfreedcommon:calendar_live reads 1 only while Harvest Feast runs, and never where a server switches
the feast off. Text.TitleKey names it on the Boosts page; its words are in harvestfeast.mmo.lang. To
change or switch it off, write this id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/boosts.json
